mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 3.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k jobs per month, the labor market's dual signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite dual labor signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns falls below 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS below $700k signals weakening residential investment, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST above 1500k units signals strengthening housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
